ma)pa la/sku gsum rig 'dus zab tig las/brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs thig le/sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig las/phrin las bde chen thig le/sku

tei:div.tei:p: ma) pa la/ sku gsum rig 'dus zab tig las/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs thig le/ sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig las/ phrin las bde chen thig le/ sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig las/ skong bshags dngos grub thig le/ sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig las/ rnam dag zhing du skye ba'i smon lam kun dga'i thig le/ sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig las/ dbang chog bde chen bum bzang*/ sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig las/ rtsa ba'i dbang bskur rgyas pa bde chen bum bzang bklag chog tu bkod pa ngo mtshar mchog gi snang ba/ sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig las/ snying po don gyi gtor dbang gi mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus pa bde chen myu gu/ bla sgrub sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i gso sbyong rdor sems zhal lung nyung ngur bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i thig le/ bka' babs bdun pa snyan brgyud kyi skor la/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig las/ sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor snying po/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa mthu stobs me 'bar/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig las/ phrin las kyi rim pa gsal bar bkod pa ye shes gsang ba'i 'khor lo/ snyan brgyud 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig gi smin grol 'bogs pa'i lag len phyag rgya gsang ba'i bcud 'dus/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig las gtor zlog gi las rim ye shes 'bar ba'i mtshon cha/ snyan brgyud 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig gi rnam bshad snying por dril ba zil gnon grub pa'i dgongs gsal/ rta mchog rol pa'i snying tig snyan brgyud rta mchog rol pa'i brgyud 'debs/ rta mchog rol pa'i snying tig las/ dbang chen tshe sgrub zab mo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po/

snyan brgyud rta mchog rol pa'i snying thig gi phrin las dang dbang bskur bklag chog tu bsdebs pa rta mchog dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra/ snyan brgyud rta mchog rol pa'i phrin las snying por dril ba/ snyan brgyud rta mgrin skong ba dngos grub char 'bebs/ dpal chen yang dag zab tig /dpal chen yang dag zab tig gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa bde chen char 'bebs/ dpal chen yang dag zab tig las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po/ yang dag rgyun khyer/ snyan brgyud yang dag zab tig gi smin grol 'bogs pa'i lag len bde chen gsang ba'i bcud 'dus/ yang phur sbrags ma'i zab tig snyan brgyud yang phur sbrags ma'i zab tig gi phrin las byang bu grub gnyis yongs 'du/ snyan brgyud yang phur zab tig las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dngos grub mchog sbyin/ snyan brgyud yang phur sbrag ma'i zab tig gi dbang gi lag len grub gnyis bcud 'bebs/ snyan brgyud yang phur sbrags ma'i gtor bzlog bdud las rnam rgyal/ snyan brgyud yang phur zab tig las/ 'gal rkyen zlog byed drag po gtor ma'i las rim mthu stobs rdo rje'i thog char/ snyan brgyud yang phur sbrag ma'i zab tig gi rnam bshad snying por dril ba grub gnyis 'dod 'jo'i dga' tshal/ snyan brgyud yang phur sbrag ma'i zab tig gi rdzogs rim gud sbas/ snyan brgyud yang phur sbrags ma'i zab tig gi rdzogs rim gud sbas kyi dmigs khrid zab gsang ḍā ka'i thugs tig mchog gi ye shes grub pa'i gseng lam/
